title: oreocallis brachycarpa
intro: Oreocallis brachycarpa, commonly known as Mountain Bellflower, is a flowering plant species native to Australia. The health benefits of Mountain Bellflower include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Bellflower include glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
